entries.title: Pioneers of Pagonia
entries.definitive_edition: Pioneers of Pagonia 1.0 on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Pioneers of Pagonia is a Windows PC release that left Early Access on December 11, 2025, with the official site stating that Linux is not officially supported. The 1.0 PC release is therefore the only sourced platform and the complete route, including the post-Early-Access campaign content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release on Steam or GOG.

entries.remaster_caveats: The GOG release adds DRM-free availability and extras; it is not a remaster. Cosmetic packs/extras are optional and do not create a separate gameplay platform.
